anomalies.observed: The Q3 gate junction (pulled up to +3V3 through R3) is routed to the SKW92A pin 31 (P4_LED) net labelled NET0016. The same NET0016 label also appears on keyboard U3 pin 23 (LEDK_2_3), so the display-power switch gate shares a net with a keyboard LED cathode.
anomalies.expected: The specification says the display-power switch gate is driven only by a SKW92A GPIO (U5.31) through a pull-up, and it never mentions a keyboard LED connection on that pin. The gate net should not also drive the keyboard LED cathode.

evidence.quote: `Net-(Q2-G)` = `Q2.1` (gate), `R2.1`→`R2.2`→`+3V3` (10 kΩ pull-up, gate defaults high/off), and `U5.31` (SKW92A GPIO, datasheet pin 31 = `P4_LED`/`GPIO#39`, repurposed here as a general output)
Page 2 (SkylabModule): NET0016 label at the gate-junction wire near U9 pin 31 (P4_LED); keyboard U3 pin 23 LEDK_2_3 labelled NET0016

anomalies.impact: If this is a real connection, keyboard LED activity could toggle the display power MOSFET, or the keyboard LED drive could be loaded by the gate pull-up, causing unintended display power cycling or leakage.

anomalies.observed: C1 is labelled 4.7uF/25V on the EPD boost-output node, while the other 25 V boost/decoupling capacitors on this sheet are 1uF/25V.
anomalies.expected: The specification lists C1 as 1 µF/25 V in the EPD driver table and matches the PDI reference values, so the value should be 1 µF/25 V.

evidence.quote: | C2 default: 1 µF/25 V | C1/C5/C7/C8/C9/C10 = 1 µF/25 V | Matches default |
Page 3 (EPD_Driver): "C1 4.7uF/25V" next to the L2 10uH boost node

anomalies.impact: A larger output capacitance on the boost node changes the boost converter's ripple and loop response, and may not match the reference design.

parsed.summary: The power, regulator and EPD driver wiring mostly match the specification, but the display-power switch gate appears to share a net with a keyboard LED cathode, and the boost capacitor C1 is labelled 4.7 µF rather than the specified 1 µF. Both findings are low to moderate confidence because they rest on net-label reads and an ambiguous spec table.
